question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ACQUIRE
solution: The correct answer is '**Disperse**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Acquire**' is '**Disperse**'. • **Acquire**: to obtain or buy something. (कुछ अर्जित करना या ख़रीदना) • *Example: The company has **acquired** shares in a rival business.* • **Disperse**: to separate and go in different directions; to make somebody/something do this. (बिखर जाना, विसर्जित हो जाना; बिखरा देना, विसर्जित कर देना) • *Example: When the meeting was over, the group **dispersed**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Disperse.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Collect**: to bring a number of things together. (विभिन्‍न वस्‍तुओं को एकत्र करना, इकट्ठा करना) • **Gain**: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want. (वस्‍तु तक पहुँचना या प्राप्‍त करना, विशेषतः अपेक्षित या अभीष्‍ट वस्‍तु; पाना) • **Earn**: to get money by working. [(पैसा) कमाना] 36:T1045, The correct answer is **'best books whom'.**
